name: dlspit
summary: A multi-domain experiment package: Deep Learning (MLP, CNN, ResNet, RNN, LSTM, Transformer, GAN, VAE), ML ESE Lab (regression, SVM, decision tree, random forest, XGBoost, k-means) Generative AI from scratch in NumPy (VAE, GAN, mini GPT, text-to-image, face swap, music, CycleGAN, chatbot, diffusion) and Explainable AI from scratch (SHAP, PDP, ICE, LIME, Grad-CAM, XRAI-style, Gradient x Input, LRP).
author: DLSPIT Team Open Source Contributor
